snippet.title: Bash Moto - Road Rash like indie game. Debut Alpha Video
snippet.description:
My solo developed project that takes heavy inspiration from the classic Road Rash series. The game will feature a similar 90s theme, rock music, a cast of bikers and a bunch of different bikes to purchase as you race through several different levels and outrun the cops.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4227280/Bash_Moto/
